<function name="SelectModel" parent="PropSelect" type="panelhook">
	<description>
<internal>Use <page>PropSelect:FindAndSelectButton</page> instead.</internal>

Selects a given spawnicon panel.
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2024.09.02</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="icon" type="SpawnIcon">The spawnicon to select, retrieved via <page>PropSelect:FindModelByValue</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
